record.paper_title: The Hamiltonian Seifert Conjecture: Examples and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Global bounded capacity of twisted cotangent bundles
record.original_question: Does the cotangent bundle T^*M equipped with a twisted symplectic structure associated with a magnetic field σ have bounded Hofer–Zehnder capacity in general? Here bounded capacity means that every relatively compact open subset has finite Hofer–Zehnder capacity. The paper records positive results for certain manifolds and local neighborhoods, but asks whether such boundedness should hold for twisted cotangent bundles in full generality.

evidence.quote: Moreover, for some manifolds M, the twisted cotangent bundle has bounded capacity, [GK, Ji, Lu].
Interestingly, there seems to be no sufficient evidence that T∗M has bounded Hofer–Zehnder capacity in general.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let M be a smooth closed manifold and let T*M be its cotangent bundle, equipped with its canonical Liouville 1-form λ. Given a closed 2-form σ on M (a "magnetic field"), let π: T*M → M denote the projection and consider the twisted symplectic form ω_σ := dλ − π*σ on T*M. The Hofer–Zehnder capacity c_HZ(U) of an open subset U ⊂ (T*M, ω_σ) is defined as the supremum of max H − min H over all smooth, compactly supported, non-negative Hamiltonians H: U → R such that H ≡ 0 on an open subset, H ≡ max H on an open subset, and the Hamiltonian flow of H has no non-constant periodic orbits of period at most 1. Say that (T*M, ω_σ) has bounded Hofer–Zehnder capacity if c_HZ(U) < ∞ for every relatively compact open subset U ⊂ T*M.

Question: Is it true that for every closed manifold M and every closed 2-form σ on M, the twisted cotangent bundle (T*M, ω_σ) has bounded Hofer–Zehnder capacity?
artifact.category_tag: Hofer-Zehnder capacity of twisted cotangent bundles
artifact.status_search_result: The general question appears still open, but substantial partial progress has been achieved. Boundedness of Hofer–Zehnder capacity has been established for various classes of manifolds and magnetic forms (e.g., tori with twisted form; constant magnetic fields on surfaces; disc tangent bundles over constant curvature surfaces; projective spaces). Recent work using symplectic cohomology for magnetic cotangent bundles shows that whenever σ is not weakly exact, the π1-sensitive Hofer–Zehnder capacity of any compact subset is finite. A fully general resolution for all closed M and all σ does not appear in the literature.

status_evidence.title: On the Hofer-Zehnder capacity for twisted tangent bundles over closed surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Determines HZ capacity for arbitrary constant magnetic fields on S^2 and strong constant magnetic fields for higher genus surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results computing HZ capacity in specific twisted settings.

status_evidence.title: Hofer–Zehnder capacity of magnetic disc tangent bundles over constant curvature surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Computes HZ capacity for magnetic disc tangent bundles over constant curvature surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial results in special geometries.

status_evidence.title: The symplectic cohomology of magnetic cotangent bundles
status_evidence.snippet: If a magnetic form is not weakly exact, then the π1-sensitive Hofer-Zehnder capacity of any compact set in the magnetic cotangent bundle is finite.
status_evidence.claim: Boundedness established under the assumption that σ is not weakly exact.

status_evidence.title: Relative Hofer-Zehnder capacity and periodic orbits in twisted cotangent bundles
status_evidence.snippet: Relative HZ capacity finiteness and consequences for periodic orbits on low energy levels.
